about.registryInfo:
Goblin Issuer Inc is the token-issuing
  entity for the Goblin Finance private credit product suite. Public
  jurisdiction and formal registration were not surfaced in disclosed
  materials. GPCI is deployed on the Pharos Mainnet as a permissioned ERC-20
  with USDC as the underlying deposit asset and settlement is coordinated
  through the Ember Protocol tokenization rail. Ember and Goblin ALM smart
  contracts have been audited by Movebit and Plainshift.
